# Archway Business Brokers

> Archway Business Brokers helps owners sell or transfer operating businesses in Vietnam with annual revenue from VND 3 billion, connects them with suitable buyers and guides the transaction process. All discussions and advisory support are free and confidential.

## About

Archway Business Brokers is a quality-first business brokerage focused on supporting business owners in Vietnam through a sale or ownership transfer.

The team guides owners through the M&A process with a clear, confidential and practical approach.

## Criteria

- Businesses operating in Vietnam.
- Operating businesses in Vietnam with annual revenue from VND 3 billion are Archway's primary focus, although the seller form can accept businesses below this level.
- Owners considering a sale or transfer.
- Buyers seeking operating businesses in Vietnam.

## Industries

- HVAC.
- Electrical Contractors.
- 3PL and freight forwarding.
- Industrial Machinery and Equipment.
- IT Outsourcing and Managed IT Services.
- Medical Equipment and Technical Services.

Archway also considers transactions in other industries.

## Services

- Business owners can discuss selling or transferring a business through the seller registration form.
- Archway provides a free and confidential initial commercial valuation assessment for owners preparing to sell. This assessment supports sale preparation and is not a certified valuation, audit, fairness opinion or legal, tax or accounting advice.
- Archway supports sale profile development, confidential buyer outreach, offer comparison, due diligence coordination and handover.
- Each industry page provides seller-focused guidance on valuation, preparation, transferability and transaction support, and links directly to the seller registration form.
- Buyers can register for suitable business acquisition opportunities through the priority buyer list.
- Visitors can review the ten-step business sale and transfer process.
- Visitors can contact Archway by form, phone, email or LinkedIn.
